plan.summary: InmaJwtValidator validated path reads CompanyId claim (INMA internal ID, e.g. 11) instead of CompanyCode (our tenant_id, e.g. 5050). Fix aligns validated path with decode-only path by trying CompanyCode first with CompanyId fallback.
plan.q_intent: InmaJwtValidator CompanyCode alignment — validated path CompanyId → CompanyCode fix
plan.interview_notes: No ambiguity — documented in session-memory.md and lessons-learned.md (#100). Decode-only path already fixed, validated path is the last remaining issue.

files_changed.change: CompanyCode first + CompanyId fallback in ValidateToken(), updated comments
Updated XML doc comments to reflect CompanyCode as primary claim

verification_questions.question: Does the validated path now try CompanyCode claim first before falling back to CompanyId?
verification_questions.codex_answer: CompanyCode first, then CompanyId via null-coalescing

verification_questions.question: Is backward compatibility preserved for tokens that only have CompanyId (no CompanyCode claim)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Falls back to CompanyId when CompanyCode is absent

verification_questions.question: Are comments and XML docs consistent with the new CompanyCode-first behavior across both files?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Updated comments in both files reference CompanyCode as primary with CompanyId fallback

intentional_exclusions: Program.cs decode-only path already uses CompanyCode first

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Both claim miss → explicit error return with descriptive message

aha_moments.user_pain: INMA SSO login fails silently when validated path reads wrong claim (CompanyId=11 instead of tenant_id=5050)
aha_moments.suggestion: Add claim mismatch warning log when CompanyCode is missing but CompanyId exists
aha_moments.aha_moment: User realizes their SSO login now consistently resolves to the correct tenant without random 403 errors

aha_moments.user_pain: Support cannot diagnose why some INMA users get wrong tenant data
aha_moments.suggestion: Log which claim was used (CompanyCode vs CompanyId fallback) for debugging
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support sees clear log entry showing claim resolution path, diagnoses issues in seconds

aha_moments.user_pain: INMA users see another tenant's data when CompanyId maps to wrong tenant_id
aha_moments.suggestion: Cross-reference resolved tenant_id against tenant_registry to verify it exists
aha_moments.aha_moment: User always sees their own tenant data, never gets confused by foreign content

aha_moments.user_pain: Validated path does two claim lookups sequentially
aha_moments.suggestion: Pre-cache claim resolution in a dictionary for O(1) lookup
aha_moments.aha_moment: Token validation is microseconds faster, no measurable user impact but cleaner code

aha_moments.user_pain: INMA integration demo fails if validated path is used and CompanyId doesn't match
aha_moments.suggestion: Ensure demo environment has both CompanyCode and CompanyId in test tokens
aha_moments.aha_moment: Sales demo works flawlessly with INMA SSO, no embarrassing tenant mismatch
